function updateCarouselRingDom(c): void;

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/autoplay.ts:197

Pushes progress into the DOM: the SVG ring's stroke-dashoffset (full circumference = empty, 0 = full circle) and the WebGL arrows' arc. The offset math lives in wasm-layout (SIMD-capable batch helper with a JS fallback) since this runs per frame.
